title: event-junkie chart values
description: Deliberately minimal: it constrains the values whose wrong setting is either unrecoverable or invisible, and nothing else. Documenting the whole value surface is values.yaml's job, and a schema that repeats it is a second thing to keep in step. Note that `database.host` and `database.existingSecret` are NOT required here even though the chart cannot render without them — the helpers reject them with a message that says what to do, which is more useful than a schema path.

pullPolicy.description: Never `Always`: every tag this chart references is immutable, so re-pulling can only find the same bytes or fail.

existingSecret.description: The name of an existing Secret. There is deliberately no `password` property anywhere in this schema, and adding one is the change to refuse in review.

runAsUser.description: Must be non-zero: `runAsNonRoot: true` and `runAsUser: 0` is a pod that fails to start, which is the good case — the bad one is a UID that exists in the image and is not the one it runs as.

basePath.description: Served by Spring itself, so the ingress path and this must agree. A leading slash and no trailing one.

replicaCount.description: Pinned to 1 by ADR-008, so that raising it fails at install time rather than in a review comment. Two schedulers means two concurrent imports of the same source: the 60-second tick skips sources marked RUNNING, but that check is a read-then-write with no lock. `SELECT … FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED` is the prerequisite for ever relaxing this, and relaxing it is an ADR change, not a values change.

port.description: Cannot be a privileged port: nginx runs as a non-root user here and cannot bind below 1024.

solver.description: http01 needs Let's Encrypt to reach the host; staging has no public address, so it uses dns01 (PLATFORM_SETUP §4a).

managementPort.description: Must differ from `port`. That the two are different is what makes /actuator/** unroutable rather than merely unrouted, since the ingress only ever names the application port.
